data.note: identical to the Zenodo EPTA-DR2 copy; replaced the pre-2023-08-23 files (1506123); the chain fingerprint confirms this version

noise_files.consumed: efac and log10_tnequad per -group backend; red/dm/chrom dict mode counts; the rn/dm_gp/cn/expd entries are not used (sampled)

script.note: original script; HEAD (0ec5705, 2024-01-23) uses chrom_var/chrom_kernel, which exist only from fork commit f8f7ba4 (2023-07-28)

enterprise_extensions.status: pinned, source-audited configuration reproducing the chain-generating model; representative of the historical equivalence class {23c63a15, 051173f4} (both after the script's orf_bins keyword, added by 23c63a15 on 2023-03-14, and before the dip-parameter rename d3248419 of 2023-03-23 that the chain names predate; 051173f4 only edits the unused binned ORF); EPTADR2-v1.1 (7619622a) differs on this path only by the rename and an unused pseed

sources.PTMCMCSampler: not recoverable; proposals only (does not enter likelihood or prior)

tempo2.binary: 2026.04.1 (conda-forge), libstempo 2.5.1 rebuilt against it: D1 profile published-tempo2-v1
tempo2.status: pinned runtime reproducing the stored likelihoods (chain fingerprint, docs/M3B0_VALIDATION.md Sec. 3); not a unique identification of every historically installed file

fourier_tspan.text: T = Tspan if Tspan is not None else toas.max() - toas.min()

toas.roster: published set: every TOA tempo2 reads, no removals (plan Sec. 4.2)

conventions.timing_model: MarginalizingTimingModel(use_svd=True): thin-SVD basis U of psr.Mmat, flat prior; logdet includes n_tm ln(1e40); no N ln(2 pi) term (fork enterprise; enterprise >= 3.5 subtracts it)
conventions.white_noise: N_ii = efac_b^2 sigma_i^2 + 10^(2 log10_tnequad_b), b = -group backend; no ECORR (all TOAs -pta EPTA)
conventions.fourier: f_k = k/T (k = 1..n), columns [sin, cos] interleaved, absolute BAT seconds (TCB)
conventions.powerlaw: phi_k = 10^(2 log10_A)/(12 pi^2) f_yr^(gamma-3) f_k^-gamma / T, f_yr = 1/(365.25 d)
conventions.temponest_dm: basis rows x (1400/nu)^idx sqrt(12) pi / (1400^2 2.41e-4), for idx 2 (DM) and 4 (chromatic)
conventions.combine: no columns merge: no pulsar spans the whole array (earliest TOA J1843-1113, latest J1640+2224)

common.modes_evidence: script CLI not released; freq_bins/freqs_dr2new.txt lists k/T_array; the chain fingerprint discriminates 9 from 8 and 10 (Sec. 6.1)

dip.waveform: d = sign 10^log10_Amp H(t - t0) exp(-(t - t0)/(10^log10_tau d)) (1400/nu)^idx, H(0) = 1

crn_pl.logging_convention: single-model PTMCMCSampler: lnpost - lnlike = physical log prior (uniform boxes)
crn_pl.columns: 67 parameters (pars.txt order) + lnpost, lnlike, acceptance, PT acceptance
crn_pl.storage: text; parameters ~22 significant digits; lnpost/lnlike 6 decimals (parsed to float64)
